fields.Name: T331 - Search Bulk Operations List
fields.Description: Exercises the studio's client-side Filtered getter (case-insensitive name/entity substring match) and onSearch handler — a self-contained filter feature, not the generic grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher and choose 'Bulk Operations' so the Operations studio list is showing. Type a query into the 'Search bulk operations…' box at the top of the list. Verify the list RESPONDS — the visible rows narrow to operations whose name or entity matches, OR a clear empty result appears if nothing matches. Then clear the box and confirm the full list returns. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. This is data-agnostic: a narrowed list, an empty result, or the empty-state (if there are no operations at all) are all valid responses to the search.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the 'Search bulk operations…' box visibly filters the operations list (fewer/no matching rows) rather than being inert
Clearing the search restores the previous list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
